param: Λ Recruitment rate into children susceptible compartment S_C (newborns)
ξ_U Un-monitored vaccination rate for children (S_C → U_C^V)
ξ_M Monitored vaccination rate for children (S_C → M_C^V)
ψ Maturation/aging rate from children to adults (applies to multiple child compartments)
β_C Transmission rate for children (force of infection multiplier for child susceptibles)
β_A Transmission rate for adults (force of infection multiplier for adult susceptibles)
ε Vaccine imperfection/leakiness factor for un-monitored vaccinated classes; infection rate multiplier for U^V (paper table lists effectiveness as (1-ε))
δ Progression rate from exposed to infectious (1/incubation period)
γ Recovery rate from infectious to immune (I → I_m)
d Disease-induced death rate (additional removal from infectious classes)
η_U Rate of becoming immune for un-monitored vaccinated children (U_C^V → I_mC)
η_M Rate of becoming immune for monitored vaccinated children (M_C^V → I_mC)
η_A Rate of becoming immune for vaccinated adults and un-monitored vaccinated adults (V_A, U_A^V → I_mA)
I_total Total infectious individuals contributing to force of infection
λ_C Force of infection acting on child susceptibles
λ_A Force of infection acting on adult susceptibles
